payload.title: Loading LiPDverse Data and Plotting as GeoSeries
payload.summary: This notebook demonstrates how to load paleoclimate datasets from the LiPDverse and create a Pyleoclim GeoSeries. It connects to the LiPDverse endpoint, retrieves specified datasets, and extracts time series data. The data is then used to construct a GeoSeries, which can be saved for further analysis. The notebook utilizes libraries such as LiPD and Pyleoclim to facilitate data handling and geospatial plotting.
goals: Create a Pyleoclim GeoSeries from the data.
Save the GeoSeries for further analysis.

section_blurbs.blurb: The notebook connects to the LiPDverse endpoint to load specified datasets. It retrieves time series data and constructs a Pyleoclim GeoSeries, which is then saved for further use.
